verbatim_excerpt: **Status rules** (evidence kinds as in joint review 13 §1; E-M plausibility is support-only):
| VERIFIED | ≥2 independent non-plausibility kinds agree within 0.5 %; none disagrees > 0.5 %; every checked dimension residual ≤ max(2 mm, 0.2 %); no declaration contradicted | ✅ | ✅ |
| CONFIRMED_BY_HUMAN | a PROVISIONAL frame confirmed by a recorded human claim | ✅ | ✅ |
| PROVISIONAL | one non-plausibility kind with no contradiction, **or** ≥2 agreeing kinds that contradict a declaration (Al Rashed) | ❌ | ✅ |
| UNCONFIRMED | declaration only, or set by an agent | ❌ | ✅ |
| CONFLICT | two independent kinds disagree > 0.5 %, or two sheets of one plan disagree | ❌ | ❌ |
| BLOCKED | no evidence other than plausibility; sheet marked not to scale; residual failure | ❌ | ❌ |

- **PREVIEW rows**: value visible in the preview/trace view only, publication status `PREVIEW`, excluded from every subtotal (subtotal `null` under the existing contract), never exported to Urban PM, watermarked on any proof.
